issue.title: Canonical pointer misses lexically indexed artifact dirs when SASE_HOME has a symlinked ancestor
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** sase _lookup_groups._query_pointer (sase repo) vs sase-core crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/index/lookup.rs query_pointer_hits and scan_agent_artifact_dir recovery via agent_scan/layout.rs parse_agent_artifact_path

**Repro:** Set SASE_HOME (or ~/.sase) under a symlinked ancestor, index agent artifacts, then look up a bundle by pointer using the canonical (resolved) path. The index query only tries [raw, canonical(raw)] and recovery does a lexical strip_prefix(projects_root), so a canonical pointer that sits under canonical(projects_root) misses both.

**Impact:** Pointer lookups silently miss on hosts where SASE_HOME has a symlinked ancestor (the macOS /var -> /private/var class). Unaffected today on hosts where ~/.sase is not symlinked. Likely fix: rebase a canonical pointer sitting under canonical(projects_root) onto the lexical projects_root before querying and recovering.

issue.creation_reason: Found while fixing sase-core's macOS canonical-path CI leg: sase sends a resolve()d canonical pointer but sase-core indexes artifact dirs lexically.
